top_signals.title: China’s Growing Ambitions in Very Low Earth Orbit
top_signals.summary:
A new front in the U.S.-Chinese space race is emerging in the lowest reaches of space: very low Earth orbit, the untapped orbital regime below 320 kilometers. top_signals.title: Who Runs the Ransomware Group Qilin?
top_signals.summary: The cybercrime group Qilin has emerged as the world's most active ransomware affiliate program, claiming at least 365 victim organizations in the past three months alone. But even top Russian hackers make operational security mistakes, and the administrator of Qilin has made a few key missteps over the last decade that all point to a 36-year-old man living in St. Petersburg, Russia.

top_signals.title: Want to Rent an Internet Address at the White House?
top_signals.summary: Several staffers at the White House are using computers or mobile devices equipped with residential proxy services that render their internet address available for others to rent, security experts warned today. One of the proxy services is a Russian company whose founder's web hosting business was ground zero for cyberattacks against election systems in Arizona and Illinois in 2016.
